text: wtf good does going from 'unannounced anonymous' to 'RSS not assigned to an owner' do thats the same thing ??? right?
resolution: Agreed that renaming unattributed RSS was not attribution. Removed the remainder concept and tile entirely. The host now parses /proc/self/smaps into a disjoint kernel-VMA partition (anonymous, main heap, executable/file, thread stacks, kernel special) whose rows sum exactly to mapped RSS; semantic Zig/V8/wgpu/compiler counters remain an explicitly overlapping drill-down. Added Zig parser coverage and TS partition tests; ReleaseFast editor build passes.
